title: IAEA Live Chart: 238U half-life 4.468E9 Y (uncertainty from the seconds column)
summary: The Live Chart row for 238U lists half-life 4.468E9 with unit Y. The seconds columns fix the absolute uncertainty at 6000000 years.
body: The IAEA Live Chart ground-state row for 238U (Z=92, N=146), extracted 2026-11-18, lists half_life 4.468E9, unit_hl Y, unc_hl 6, half_life_sec 1.4099634525447706e17, and unc_hls 189341555847552. Dividing half_life_sec by half_life gives 31556926 seconds per unit, so unit code Y is years in this row. Dividing unc_hls by that same number gives an absolute uncertainty of 6000000 years. The small integer unc_hl (6) matches that absolute uncertainty as 6 in the last significant place of the printed half-life, not as 6 years on its own. The leading decay field is A at 100 percent. The abundance field is 99.2742 with unc_a 0.0010. The row's ENSDF publication cut-off field is 1-Jun-2014. This is the database row, not a new laboratory measurement made for this card.
